lines.zh: 我边走边念自己的名字
lines.en: I chant my own name as I walk
My name is longer than the road
I keep a beat, step by step
I wobble, but in rhythm
I run out of breath by the third word

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上打拍子
lines.en: My shadow keeps time on the ground
I sway and count the beats
I drawl my way forward
I repeat the middle of it
I walk along the edge of the grass
I chant my name like a song
I come along with a hitch
I walk with the words strung together
I count one, two, then lift a foot
I start it over from the top
I stop to remember the rest
I open my mouth wide
I keep time on the spot
I forget where I was
I clear my throat
My head bobs along
I take my time to breathe
I stare at the sky a while
I count on my fingers
I break the name into parts
I hum that tune
I bite down on the next sound
I scratch my chin
Do you want to hear my name
My name has fourteen words
I can start the moment I speak
Once you hear it you will not forget
Listen, and do not interrupt
I stop halfway through
And I start over
Tell me if I have it right
I bring my mouth close to you
I stop and clear my throat
I put my face right up to yours
I forget the next line
I sway back two steps

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的拍子
lines.en: That broke my beat
I stop and catch my breath
I cover my mouth and go quiet
I swallow the words back
And I keep going
Do not cut me off
I can still chant
I stop to sniff it
I lift it up, ready to throw.
Give it to me and I will go on
I chew and chant together
Do not break my rhythm

lines.zh: 我的名字比这条路还长。
lines.en: My name is longer than this road.
This will not fill me
I will keep chanting after
The bump makes me lose a word

lines.zh: 我稳住脚，手里的东西没掉。
lines.en: I steady my feet; what I hold stays put.
I start the whole name again
You have broken my beat
I steady myself on your shoulder
We clash loudly
Half my name is gone
I tip my head and think

lines.zh: 名字太长，我差点忘了还手。
lines.en: My name is so long I nearly forgot to hit back.

lines.zh: 我的名字里没有这一段
lines.en: That part is not in my name
If you would listen to me chant
I chant better than I talk
I have not thought that through
I forget halfway
I chant when I am alone too
Could we chant it together
Two names make it longer
I shake my head, then nod
I will start over instead
I pick it up and bite first
I will keep this by my hand
I chant its name as I lift it
This has no name, does it
Then let me give it one
I will throw it and see
I pick up another
This one is good to throw
I hold it and chant one line
I set it by my feet
I stop chanting
I can hit this
I raise my hand
Do not walk off yet
Let me try my luck
This throw is my name
I will come from this side
You are right in front of me
I have a handful ready
I chant one more line
Hold still, I am throwing
One hand up, one pointing
You shifted left a step
I chant and aim at once
It flies faster than I chant
Do not hide behind that tree
I switch to the other hand
Something in my hand, raised high.
My chanting is speeding up
Can you hear me counting
I throw this one more
I wait for you to come out

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西扔出去
lines.en: I hurl what I am holding
It hits your shoulder
I snatch another handful
That throw went wide
I chant and let fly
It lands by your feet
One flick of my wrist
I bump you and pull back
I duck aside after throwing
I still have more in hand
A long string of words drifts over
I come walking, chanting
My name arrives before I do
I pop up from behind the grass
I stop halfway through a word
I appear here, head tilted
My voice comes before my body
I come in on the beat

lines.zh: 你听见我念的东西了吗
lines.en: Did you catch what I chanted
I approach, counting time

lines.zh: 我把开头那三个词先念了
lines.en: I chant the first three words first
My voice spreads over the grass
The fire makes me forget the words
I land too hard to chant a line
Water fills my mouth and the chant stops
The blast rolls me over
An arrow cuts my chant short
Magic ties my tongue in knots
Hunger leaves my chant thin
The thunder drowns my name
I chant as I fall
